AI-Enabled Software Delivery Transformation

Help your team change how it builds and maintains software with AI. We work with analysts, developers, testers and leaders to clarify requirements, shape manageable tasks, strengthen design and review practices, and make new responsibilities workable.

02 / OUR APPROACH

Understand the people.
Build the ground for change.

Clear purpose. Shared ownership.
Practical change, tested through delivery.

STRONG GROUND / PURPOSE & PEOPLE

Agree what matters.
Make ownership clear.

We listen to the people doing the work: what already works, where the pressure sits, and what they hope to gain or fear losing. Together we agree outcomes, quality commitments, responsibilities and human decision rights.

People help shape the change. We connect new practices to their goals and contribution, while making uncertainty and tradeoffs explicit.

Listen → Clarify → Agree
PLUMBING / PRACTICE & LEARNING

Make change workable.
Learn from real delivery.

We build the practical support: shared business language, focused specifications, appropriate design patterns, tests, pull request reviews, training and feedback. Existing approval gates connect decisions to evidence.

We pilot a manageable increment and measure quality, time, total effort, cost and team experience. We adapt before expanding and leave clear ownership with the team.

Pilot → Learn → Sustain
  1. Understand
  2. Agree outcomes
  3. Co-design
  4. Pilot & verify
  5. Enable & adopt
  6. Measure & improve

↶ Review, security and accountable human decisions span delivery. Outcomes and people’s experience shape the next increment.

A closer look at our engineering method ＋

Shared domain definitions connect intent to focused specifications and acceptance examples. We plan small end-to-end increments, give coding agents relevant context, and use established design patterns when they improve clarity and maintainability. Pull requests link changes to requirements, review and executed tests; integration checks verify that the pieces work together.

For agentic solutions, approved business authority guides technical architecture, tool permissions and evaluation. For delivery transformation, we also address roles, learning time, review capacity and support. Read why we use specification-driven delivery.

We adapt practices and tools such as GitHub Spec Kit where they solve a concrete problem. We refine our method through real increments and evaluate benefits against a baseline; faster code generation alone does not establish better delivery.

03 / POSSIBILITIES IN PRACTICE

Where this approach
can help.

Illustrative workflows.
Clear review points. Measurable objectives.

ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW / 01

Requirements &
delivery intelligence

Keep intent, acceptance criteria and testing connected.

Trigger & knowledge
A Jira story is ready for review; consult relevant Confluence requirements and rules.
Agent action
Identify gaps in acceptance criteria and draft test cases with supporting context.
Human checkpoint
A business analyst reviews before updates are published.
Proposed measures
Review effort, rework and suggestion acceptance rate.
ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW / 02

Operational
case preparation

Bring the evidence together before a person decides.

Trigger & knowledge
A case needs preparation; gather approved records and relevant policy material.
Agent action
Flag missing information and draft an evidence-linked summary, for example for KYC review.
Human checkpoint
An authorized reviewer assesses the case. Regulatory decisions remain human.
Proposed measures
Handling time, factual accuracy and exception frequency.
ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW / 03

Release
readiness

Make the decision easier to examine and explain.

Trigger & knowledge
A release approaches its review; collect requirements, test evidence and unresolved issues.
Agent action
Consolidate readiness evidence and highlight gaps for a go/no-go discussion.
Human checkpoint
The accountable release owner retains the release decision.
Proposed measures
Preparation effort, evidence completeness and cost per completed task.

Shervin Sadeghi brings senior business and business systems analysis experience in banking and wealth management, including roles at RBC, CIBC and TD.

His work spans KYC/AML, investment performance, requirements, data mapping, SQL validation, acceptance criteria, SIT/UAT, production verification and release readiness.
